claim_title: Hormonal birth control clears hormonal acne
caption: **Birth control and acne.** The single reviewed study compared women starting different contraceptives and found combined oral pills linked to slightly less new acne than IUDs — but the difference between methods was **less than 1%**. It did not test whether birth control clears acne someone already has, and it couldn't identify acne as specifically hormonal. That leaves the claim untested rather than confirmed.
subtitle: One study found a difference under 1% and did not test clearing existing acne.
